postal_system.transition_rule: On 2026-08-27 NIPOST still describes the numeric postcode system for mail processing, while postcode.gov.ng schedules the National Digital Alphanumeric Postcode nationwide launch for 2026-10-01. Eleven-character syntax must not be promoted before its effective time or without a current official assignment response, version and digest.
postal_system.postcode_rule: Normalize exactly six Unicode-compatible digits for the current numeric form or eleven mixed uppercase alphanumeric characters for the scheduled digital form. Syntax alone does not prove a current NIPOST assignment, deliverability, postal area, address or building.
postal_system.assignment_rule: Store a permitted minimized NIPOST observation with code-system generation, query dimensions, returned identifiers, observed_at, valid_from, valid_to, selected fields, response digest and terms snapshot. The empty legacy finder page and forthcoming developer portal are not documented unrestricted bulk APIs.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No verified reusable nationwide NIPOST postcode-polygon release is bundled. A postcode text, post-office point, district, LGA, ward, EA, locality, route, buffer, Voronoi cell, model surface, OSM feature or AGID cell is not an official postcode polygon. A rights-cleared crosswalk may create only a derived review surface with method, edition, uncertainty, exclusions and digests; canonical geometry requires explicit NIPOST authority for the same assignment and time.
postal_system.administrative_rule: State or FCT, LGA, ward or registration area, enumeration area, district and locality identities and geometries remain separate from NIPOST assignments. NPC EAD data is census/statistical context available under controlled terms, not postal geometry or a public address-building relation.
postal_system.address_rule: The 2017 national standard and dated UPU sheet define address components and keep street, property, organisation, P.O. Box, PMB and delivery information typed separately. They are methodology and format references, not current public address rows, coordinates, delivery entitlement or redistribution permission.
postal_system.building_rule: Before 2026-10-01 an eleven-character-shaped value cannot identify a live national digital building. After launch, exact display requires a current official NIPOST digital assignment or stable rights-cleared civic-address identifier plus an explicit authoritative address-to-building relation, validity and digest. Containment, text matching, parcel overlap, nearest footprint or model score supplies candidate context only.
postal_system.cadastre_rule: FCT AGIS and each state or local land/address system remain jurisdiction-specific controlled partitions. A parcel, property code, title, owner or occupant record is not a national NIPOST assignment, postcode polygon or automatic address-to-building link.
postal_system.realtime_and_model_rule: Realtime lookup improves currency only through timeout, rate, provenance, observed/effective time, cache and failure controls. Models may normalize names, detect drift, rank crosswalk candidates and estimate uncertainty-bearing non-canonical surfaces; they cannot create an official assignment, effective date, boundary, civic address or building relation.
postal_system.compression_rule: Rights-cleared polygons may be simplified, quantized and packaged as PMTiles only after topology, maximum-error and crosswalk tests. Source rights, edition, transformation chain, uncertainty and digests remain attached; compression never upgrades authority.
postal_system.licence_rule: Each artifact pins provider, exact resource, contract or licence, attribution, version, fields and digest. Public lookup visibility, an all-rights-reserved site, a standard or a future developer portal does not grant database extraction, training, mirroring or redistribution rights; OSM remains a separately attributed ODbL partition.
postal_system.privacy_rule: The Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 and NDPC GAID 2025 govern precise addresses, building-level codes, coordinates, residents, owners, occupants and query trails. Minimize collection, establish lawful purpose, apply DPIA/security/retention/access controls and review processor and cross-border safeguards; public visibility does not remove these duties.
postal_system.hosting_rule: Cloudflare and Hugging Face may host only rights-cleared non-personal immutable artifacts pinned to releases or Hub commits with verified digests. Precise private addresses, building-code relations, persons, cadastral/title data, deliveries, credentials and sensitive query logs stay in approved controlled infrastructure after Nigerian privacy, processor and cross-border review.
postal_system.temporal_rule: The addressing standard is dated July 2017, the UPU reference is dated, the digital system is scheduled for 2026-10-01, and administrative/cadastral layers have independent editions. Every production assertion stores source edition, observed_at, valid_from, valid_to, supersession and digest; a future launch statement is not backdated.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index and versioned crosswalk. It does not become a NIPOST numeric postcode, eleven-character digital code, official postal polygon, state/LGA/ward/EA boundary, parcel, civic address, exact building or delivery entitlement.
